video_goal: Demonstrate a seamless neckline blend on a mannequin head using the taper lever adjustments of a BaByliss PRO GoldFX clipper.
required_subjects_and_props: BaByliss PRO GoldFX clipper, mannequin head with hair, small fade brush

outline_steps.visual_action: A hand picks up the gleaming gold BaByliss PRO GoldFX clipper from a wooden table, bringing it next to the back of a mannequin head.
The thumb pushes the side taper lever of the GoldFX clipper upward into the fully closed position.
The clipper blade is pressed flat against the bottom edge of the mannequin head's neckline.
The clipper moves upward in a short, outward-flicking C-stroke motion, cutting the bottom layer of synthetic hair to create a baseline.
The thumb pulls the taper lever down exactly halfway, visibly exposing slightly more of the cutting blade.
The clipper is positioned half an inch above the newly cut baseline on the mannequin's neck.
The clipper glides upward with another C-stroke, blending the hair into the section just above the baseline.
The thumb pulls the taper lever all the way down to the fully open position.
The clipper is placed another half-inch higher on the mannequin's neckline, just below the bulk of the longer hair.
The clipper sweeps upward and flicks outward, seamlessly blending the faded section into the longer hair above.
A small wooden fade brush sweeps rapidly across the mannequin's neck, clearing away the cut hair clippings.
The camera slowly pans across the back of the mannequin head, revealing a smooth, blended gradient on the neckline.
